_why: Task: 'one fresh, complete set of screenshots ... INCLUDING hard states' (2026-09-24), priority list names 'Remote Access incl. set-up/not-set-up/error'. remote-phone.json only captures the PAIRED post-login phone state; main.json's settings-remote-access opens the default (disconnected, no Tailscale switch) desktop panel. Neither exercises the `?remotePreview=<state>` switch (README's Workbench switches list; consumed for real by SettingsPanel.tsx:1623 `previewApi`, NOT just the dev-only RemoteSetup.tsx mockup) that drives every stage createRemoteAccessPreview knows about: setup/not-installed/sign-in-required (three distinct 'not set up' reasons), consent, checking, checked/checked-failed/checked-silent (three distinct outcomes of the end-of-setup check), ready, conflict, error, disabled. Each shot's own `url` overrides the plan `base` with its state (shot.mjs: `s.url ?? plan.base`), so one plan file can hit every stage without per-shot query juggling. Click path matches main.json's `settings-remote-access`: gear -> the 'Remote Access' settings row.

shots.name: remote-not-set-up
shots._why: prerequisite='not-installed' (SettingsPanel.tsx renderPreviewSetup): 'Not set up yet.' + Install Tailscale button — the true never-configured state.

shots.name: remote-sign-in-required
shots._why: prerequisite='sign-in-required': Tailscale installed but the user never signed in — a different 'not set up' reason from remote-not-set-up, with its own copy and button.

shots.name: remote-setup
shots._why: stage='setup': the plain not-set-up-yet screen reached once Tailscale IS installed and signed in (no prerequisite blocker) — the row subtitle for this stage is 'Set up secure access' (SettingsPanel.tsx previewLabels).

shots.name: remote-consent
shots._why: stage='consent': the public-record consent screen for the optional browser-encryption level — the one place this consent copy appears (act.advanced branch).

shots.name: remote-checking
shots._why: stage='checking': in-progress/loading state — 'Checking this computer's connection…' busy strip, before the end-of-setup check resolves.

shots.name: remote-checked-listening
shots._why: checked+listening:true: the success answer of the end-of-setup check, with a real address.

shots.name: remote-checked-failed
shots._why: checked+listening:false+reason set (EADDRINUSE): the check's failure WITH a cause, plainReason()-translated per error-message-standards.md, Retry offered.

shots.name: remote-checked-silent
shots._why: checked+listening:false+reason:null: the check's failure WITHOUT a cause — deliberately a different screen from checked-failed (ErrorState general, Report bug + Diagnose, per docs/error-message-standards.md's 'never invent an error cause').

shots.name: remote-ready
shots._why: stage='ready': fully working, paired-capable state (devices list populated) — the panel's normal/happy path, for contrast against every hard state above.

shots.name: remote-conflict
shots._why: stage='conflict': the address is already in use by another service on this machine — a distinct error from checked-failed's generic EADDRINUSE (this one names the real cause instead of a check's silent failure).
shots.expect: js:document.body.textContent.includes('already using this address for another service')

shots.name: remote-error
shots._why: stage='error': the setup process itself failed with no reason to show, per docs/error-message-standards.md — Report bug + Diagnose, never a fabricated cause.

shots.name: remote-disabled
shots._why: stage='disabled': remote access explicitly turned off — the panel's own idle/off state, distinct from never-set-up.
